messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 2D Mario-style platformer starring a frog-man ("hombre sapo"), with obstacles, enemies, coins, levels, and mobile support.

## Requirements
- Spanish-language game and UI (user wrote in Spanish).
- 2D side-scroller with Mario Bros-like obstacles (platforms, pipes, gaps, spikes, enemies).
- Must support Android/iOS touch controls and safe areas per project conventions.
- Verify in a real browser with screenshots; don't claim GPU acceleration (SwiftShader CPU).

## Decisions
- Self-contained HTML5 canvas game, no build step, no external assets; procedural art and WebAudio synthesized music/SFX.
- Split code into `js/audio.js`, `js/levels.js`, `js/core.js`, `js/render-world.js`, `js/render-actors.js`, `js/game.js`.
- 3 levels built with a `Builder` class, tile size 48, logical viewport 960×576, 12 tile rows.
- Mechanics: run, variable jump, coyote time, jump buffer, double jump, tongue attack (kills enemies, attracts coins), stomp, checkpoints, hearts, moving platforms, 4 enemy types (snail, mosquito, urchin, plus hazards), 3 lives, 50-coin extra life, timer, score, best score/unlock persistence in localStorage.
- Render internal resolution fixed at 960×576 (no DPR scaling) for performance; CSS scales the canvas.
- Debug hook enabled only with `?debug=1`: `window.__sapo = { game, startLevel, startRun, completeLevel, respawnPlayer, input, progress }`; force touch UI with `?touch=1`.
- Local dev server on port 3002 via `server.mjs`/`package.json`.

## Work State
### Completed
- All game code files written; `node --check` passes.
- Levels validated: row widths, coin/enemy placement, checkpoints/goals/spawns on solid ground (only flies intentionally have no floor).
- Browser-tested title, gameplay, tongue, double jump, stomping, tongue kills, water death, checkpoint respawn, level completion, level 2/3 visuals, moving-platform riding, game over screen.
- Visual fixes applied: removed red scarf that looked like a beak, added belt/buckle, larger smile, timer clock spacing, lighter overlay blur, SVG lock icons for locked levels, lighter title backdrop.
- Performance work: cached sun/mist/firefly glow sprites, reduced trees/vines/fireflies, fixed DPR to 1, removed attack ring effect.
- Fixed `prevFeet` assignment (stomps previously impossible) and moving-platform jump/onGround edge case.

### Active
- Adding a portrait rotate hint and testing mobile layouts (`?touch=1`).
- Last attempted edit was a no-op (identical old/new string) when adding a rotate hint element to `index.html`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add `.rotate-hint` element/HTML + CSS (portrait + `body.touch-mode`, hidden in menu) and optionally text in title.
2. Reload, clear localStorage for fresh state, screenshot title (1440×900) to verify lock SVGs/lighter overlay.
3. Test mobile portrait 390×844 and landscape 844×390 with `?touch=1`; verify controls not overlapping and safe areas.
4. Test block bump (`?` block under head) and inspect updated background fireflies/timer HUD.
5. Test final-level win flow (`startLevel(2)`, reach goal, click "Ver final").
6. Update `README.md` with game description and `npm start` instructions; optionally remove QA screenshots.
7. Final full-page screenshots; confirm no console errors.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page skeleton, canvas, overlay, HUD buttons, touch controls; script order audio→levels→core→render-world→render-actors→game.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: game loop, states, input, UI screens, collisions, camera, debug hook.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/core.js`: World, Player physics, enemies, movers, FX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/levels.js`: Builder + 3 level definitions/themes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render-world.js`: background/water/tiles/goal/checkpoint/mover rendering + cached glow sprites.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render-actors.js`: player/enemy/coin/heart/HUD rendering.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synthesized SFX and looping music.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: full UI/touch/overlay styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/server.mjs`: static server port 3002.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/package.json`: `npm start`/`dev` scripts.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: QA screenshots (title, gameplay, goal, level complete, game over, map).

## Important Context
- Dev server is running in tmux session `sapo` on port 3002 (`http://localhost:3002`), logging to `/tmp/opencode/sapo.log`.
- Playwright CLI works after `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; it uses SwiftShader CPU rendering and throttles to ~6–10 fps for this canvas (blank page ~40 fps) — performance measurements here are environment-limited.
- `localStorage` key is `sapo-salvaje-v1`; QA testing unlocked level 2, so clear it for fresh-state screenshots.
- Level 1 goal at col 122 row 6; score bonus = timeLeft×10 + 100.
- `game.stage` is a preview of level 1 while on the title screen; `game.player` is null there.
- Screenshots are not yet committed; working tree changes are uncommitted.

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## 🐸 Sapo Salvaje

Plataformas 2D en HTML5 Canvas protagonizado por un hombre sapo. Cruza tres pantanos, pisa bichos, atrapa luciérnagas con la lengua y llega a la flor de loto.

Todo el juego es autocontenido: arte procedural, música y efectos sintetizados con WebAudio, sin imágenes ni dependencias externas.

### ▶️ Cómo jugar

```bash
npm start
```

Abre <http://localhost:3002>. También puedes servir la carpeta con cualquier servidor estático.

### 🎮 Controles

| Acción | Teclado | Móvil |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Moverse | `←` `→` / `A` `D` | Botones laterales |
| Saltar | `Espacio` / `↑` / `W` | Botón de salto |
| Doble salto | Salta otra vez en el aire | Toca salto otra vez |
| Lengua | `X` / `J` | Botón LENGUA |
| Pausa | `P` / `Esc` | Botón de pausa |

En el móvil gira el dispositivo a horizontal. La pantalla de aviso y la pausa automática evitan que pierdas una vida al rotar.

### ✨ Mecánicas

- Tres niveles con temas, enemigos y plataformas móviles propias.
- Salto variable, coyote time, buffer de salto y doble salto.

+
+Todo el juego es autocontenido: arte procedural, música y efectos sintetizados con WebAudio, sin imágenes ni dependencias externas.
+
+### ▶️ Cómo jugar
+
+```bash
+npm start
+```
+
+Abre <http://localhost:3002>. También puedes servir la carpeta con cualquier servidor estático.
+
+### 🎮 Controles
+
+| Acción | Teclado | Móvil |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Moverse | `←` `→` / `A` `D` | Botones laterales |
+| Saltar | `Espacio` / `↑` / `W` | Botón de salto |
+| Doble salto | Salta otra vez en el aire | Toca salto otra vez |
+| Lengua | `X` / `J` | Botón LENGUA |
+| Pausa | `P` / `Esc` | Botón de pausa |
+
+En el móvil gira el dispositivo a horizontal. La pantalla de aviso y la pausa automática evitan que pierdas una vida al rotar.
